segments.an10.46:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
segments.an10.46:1.2: Atha kho sambahulā sakkā upāsakā tadahuposathe yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinne kho sakke upāsake bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.an10.46:1.3: “api nu tumhe, sakkā, aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasathā”ti?
segments.an10.46:1.4: “Appekadā mayaṃ, bhante, aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasāma, appekadā na upavasāmā”ti.
segments.an10.46:1.5: “Tesaṃ vo, sakkā, alābhā tesaṃ dulladdhaṃ, ye tumhe evaṃ sokasabhaye jīvite maraṇasabhaye jīvite appekadā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasatha, appekadā na upavasatha.
segments.an10.46:2.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, sakkā, idha puriso yena kenaci kammaṭṭhānena anāpajja akusalaṃ divasaṃ aḍḍhakahāpaṇaṃ nibbiseyya.
segments.an10.46:3.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, sakkā, idha puriso yena kenaci kammaṭṭhānena anāpajja akusalaṃ divasaṃ kahāpaṇaṃ nibbiseyya.
segments.an10.46:4.1: “Taṃ kiṃ, maññatha, sakkā, idha puriso yena kenaci kammaṭṭhānena anāpajja akusalaṃ divasaṃ dve kahāpaṇe nibbiseyya … tayo kahāpaṇe nibbiseyya … cattāro kahāpaṇe nibbiseyya … pañca kahāpaṇe nibbiseyya … cha kahāpaṇe nibbiseyya … satta kahāpaṇe nibbiseyya … aṭṭha kahāpaṇe nibbiseyya … nava kahāpaṇe nibbiseyya … dasa kahāpaṇe nibbiseyya … vīsa kahāpaṇe nibbiseyya … tiṃsa kahāpaṇe nibbiseyya … cattārīsaṃ kahāpaṇe nibbiseyya … paññāsaṃ kahāpaṇe nibbiseyya … kahāpaṇasataṃ nibbiseyya.
segments.an10.46:5.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, sakkā, api nu so puriso divase divase kahāpaṇasataṃ kahāpaṇasahassaṃ nibbisamāno laddhaṃ laddhaṃ nikkhipanto vassasatāyuko vassasatajīvī mahantaṃ bhogakkhandhaṃ adhigaccheyyā”ti?
segments.an10.46:6.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, sakkā, api nu so puriso bhogahetu bhoganidānaṃ bhogādhikaraṇaṃ ekaṃ vā rattiṃ ekaṃ vā divasaṃ upaḍḍhaṃ vā rattiṃ upaḍḍhaṃ vā divasaṃ ekantasukhappaṭisaṃvedī vihareyyā”ti?
segments.an10.46:6.5: “Kāmā hi, bhante, aniccā tucchā musā mosadhammā”ti.
segments.an10.46:7.1: “Idha pana vo, sakkā, mama sāvako dasa vassāni appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto yathā mayānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno satampi vassāni satampi vassasatāni satampi vassasahassāni ekantasukhappaṭisaṃvedī vihareyya.
segments.an10.46:7.2: So ca khvassa sakadāgāmī vā anāgāmī vā apaṇṇakaṃ vā sotāpanno.
segments.an10.46:8.1: Idha mama sāvako nava vassāni … aṭṭha vassāni … satta vassāni … cha vassāni … pañca vassāni cattāri vassāni … tīṇi vassāni … dve vassāni … ekaṃ vassaṃ appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto yathā mayānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno satampi vassāni satampi vassasatāni satampi vassasahassāni ekantasukhappaṭisaṃvedī vihareyya, so ca khvassa sakadāgāmī vā anāgāmī vā apaṇṇakaṃ vā sotāpanno.
segments.an10.46:9.1: Idha mama sāvako dasa māse appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto yathā mayānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno satampi vassāni satampi vassasatāni satampi vassasahassāni ekantasukhappaṭisaṃvedī vihareyya, so ca khvassa sakadāgāmī vā anāgāmī vā apaṇṇakaṃ vā sotāpanno.
segments.an10.46:10.1: Idha mama sāvako nava māse … aṭṭha māse … satta māse … cha māse … pañca māse … cattāro māse … tayo māse … dve māse … ekaṃ māsaṃ … aḍḍhamāsaṃ appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto yathā mayānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno satampi vassāni satampi vassasatāni satampi vassasahassāni ekantasukhappaṭisaṃvedī vihareyya, so ca khvassa sakadāgāmī vā anāgāmī vā apaṇṇakaṃ vā sotāpanno.
segments.an10.46:11.1: Idha mama sāvako dasa rattindive [rattidive (ka.)] appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto yathā mayānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno satampi vassāni satampi vassasatāni satampi vassasahassāni ekantasukhappaṭisaṃvedī vihareyya, so ca khvassa sakadāgāmī vā anāgāmī vā apaṇṇakaṃ vā sotāpanno.
segments.an10.46:12.1: Idha mama sāvako nava rattindive … aṭṭha rattindive … satta rattindive … cha rattindive … pañca rattindive … cattāro rattindive … tayo rattindive … dve rattindive … ekaṃ rattindivaṃ appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto yathā mayānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamāno satampi vassāni satampi vassasatāni satampi vassasahassāni ekantasukhappaṭisaṃvedī vihareyya, so ca khvassa sakadāgāmī vā anāgāmī vā apaṇṇakaṃ vā sotāpanno.
segments.an10.46:12.10: Tesaṃ vo, sakkā, alābhā tesaṃ dulladdhaṃ, ye tumhe evaṃ sokasabhaye jīvite maraṇasabhaye jīvite appekadā aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasatha, appekadā na upavasathā”ti.
segments.an10.46:12.11: “Ete mayaṃ, bhante, ajjatagge aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgataṃ uposathaṃ upavasissāmā”ti.

lines: Yena kenaci kammaṭṭhānenāti kasivaṇijjādikammesu yena kenaci kammena.
Ekantasukhappaṭisaṃvedī vihareyyāti ekantameva kāyikacetasikasukhaṃ ñāṇena paṭisaṃvedento vihareyya.
Musāti niccasubhasukhā viya khāyamānāpi tathā na hontīti musā.
Tasmā te paṭicca dukkhaṃ uppajjatīti sandasseti.
Apaṇṇakaṃ vā sotāpannoti avirādhitaṃ ekaṃsena sotāpanno vā hoti.
Sopi jhānaṃ nibbatteti, brahmalokaṃ vā gantvā chasu vā kāmasaggesu ekantasukhappaṭisaṃvedī hutvā vihareyya.
Imasmiṃ sutte satthā aṭṭhaṅguposathassa guṇaṃ kathesi.
Chaṭṭhe khaṇabhaṅguratāya na niccā na dhuvāti aniccā.
Tato eva paṇḍitehi na iccā na upagantabbātipi aniccā.
Svāyaṃ nesaṃ aniccaṭṭho udayavayaparicchinnatāya veditabboti āha “hutvā abhāvino”ti, uppajjitvā vinassakāti attho.
Musāti visaṃvādanaṭṭhena musā, ekaṃsena asubhādisabhāvā te bālānaṃ subhādibhāvena upaṭṭhahanti, subhādiggahaṇassa paccayabhāvena satte visaṃvādenti.
Na passanasabhāvāti khaṇapabhaṅguratāittarapaccupaṭṭhānatāya dissamānā viya hutvā adassanapakatikā.
Ete hi khettaṃ viya vatthu viya hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ viya ca paññāyitvāpi katipāheneva supinake diṭṭhā viya na paññāyanti.
